title: A SCOPING REVIEW OF THE ETHICAL PERSPECTIVES ON ANTHROPOMORPHISING LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL-BASED CONVERSATIONAL AGENTS
reasoning: This paper is a scoping review dedicated specifically to analyzing the ethical and normative literature regarding the anthropomorphisation of LLM-based conversational agents. It evaluates various ethical challenges like deception, autonomy, and justice, and maps out normative stakes and theoretical foundations in the field of AI ethics.
